findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

On arrival the hand sink in the bar area was without soap. The dispenser was replaced during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The inside of the nozzle for the soda gun was observed to have accumulated filth. The PIC was shown and cleaned the item during this inspection to correct. Regular cleaning was discussed. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained clean and sanitized at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Multiple fruit/drain flies are observed in the facility primarily in the bar area, around the kitchen hand sink and the dry preparation hallway in front of the walk in cooler. The PIC was shown and instructed to contact pest control for maintenance. Cleaning of the drains and facility was discussed. Ensure that the facility is maintained free of pests at all times.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.citation_text:
5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

The left basin of the three part sink was observed leaking out of the left most side. The PICs were consulted and stated that plumbers had already been out and worked on the sink. Tape is observed on the outside of the sink and appears to have worn off. A rubber sealant was also observed to have worn away. The repairs are no longer effective and need to be redone. The specific basin is being taken out of service at the time of this inspection as a temporary corrective measure. It will need to be repaired prior to use. The inspector will follow up on this situation at the time of the previously scheduled follow-up for flies.
